## Complete Menu Breakdown
### 1. Seafood Boils (Sold by the Pound & Combos)
- **Captain's Ultimate Seafood Boil Combo**: 1 lb Snow Crab Clusters, 1 lb Jumbo Gulf Shrimp, 1 lb Crawfish with sweet corn, red potatoes, and sliced smoked andouille sausage drenched in proprietary Cajun garlic butter.
- **Colossal Snow Crab Clusters**: Sweet, tender, flaky snow crab legs steamed fresh and tossed in chosen boil sauce and heat level.
- **Live Louisiana Crawfish Boil**: Plump crawfish boiled in a 14-spice bayou seasoning blend, served piping hot with garlic butter dip.
- **Alaskan King Crab Feast**: Giant King Crab legs split for easy cracking, soaked in rich clarified garlic herb butter.
- **Jumbo Gulf Coast Shrimp Boil**: Fresh locally sourced Gulf shrimp boiled shell-on to retain peak juiciness.
- **New Zealand Green Mussels & Clams Boil**: Meaty green-lipped mussels and clams in fragrant Cajun garlic broth.

### 2. Golden Fried Baskets & Platters
- **Crispy Golden Fried Gulf Flounder**: Flaky white flounder fillets coated in crispy seasoned cornmeal crust with Cajun fries, hushpuppies, and house remoulade.
- **Southern Delta Catfish Platter**: Farm-raised catfish fillets dusted in traditional Cajun cornmeal spice with tartar sauce.
- **Crispy Jumbo Butterfly Shrimp Basket**: Hand-breaded jumbo Gulf shrimp with fries and cocktail sauce.
- **Golden Fried Gulf Oysters Basket**: Fresh Gulf oysters flash-fried to golden perfection.
- **Captain's Grand Fried Seafood Sampler**: Combo of flounder, catfish, shrimp, and oysters.

### 3. Southern & Cajun Specialties
- **Authentic Bayou Seafood Gumbo**: 6-hour simmered dark mahogany roux with blue crab, Gulf shrimp, smoked andouille sausage, and okra over rice.
- **Classic Louisiana Crawfish Étouffée**: Crawfish tails smothered in velvety blonde butter roux over jasmine rice.
- **Famous New Orleans Po' Boys**: French baguette loaded with Fried Shrimp, Catfish, or Oysters and zesty remoulade.
- **Wok-Tossed Cajun Garlic Butter Noodles**: Springy egg noodles tossed at high heat in rich garlic butter, secret Cajun spice glaze, and parmesan.

### 4. Bayou Starters & Sides
- **Crispy Cajun Boudin Balls**: Pork and rice sausage rolled in panko, fried crispy with spicy bayou dip.
- **Crispy Louisiana Gator Bites**: Alligator tail meat with chipotle remoulade.
- **Golden Sweet Corn Hushpuppies**: Sweet cornmeal fritters with honey butter.
- **Boil Add-Ons**: Corn on the cob, red potatoes, andouille sausage links.

## Ordering & Reservations
Guests can book tables or pre-order hot takeout directly via the interactive online wizard at https://captainpaulscajunseafood.com or by calling (361) 444-5086.
